content.title: Euphoria Season 3 Release Date, Time, Where to Watch
content.text: Juliana Margulies joins ' Paradise' Season 2 - Jamie McCarthy / Getty ImagesParadise Season 3 is taking shape at Hulu following its showstopping Season 2 finale, and the drama from creator Dan Fogelman is already adding new stars to the mix, with Julianna Margulies being the latest to join the fray. Renewed on March 17, 2026, for Season 3, Paradise‘s return promises the continuation of Xavier Collins’ (Sterling K. Brown) story as he attempts to save the world.The renewal didn’t come as a major surprise, as series creator Fogelman and star Brown had previously teased a three-season plan for the story. Thankfully, Hulu is making way for the full arc they’d intended. While Season 2 may have just wrapped, the arrival of Season 3 is closer than before, with filming already in motion. Below, we’re breaking down everything we know about Paradise Season 3 already. Scroll down for a closer look and stay tuned for any major reveals surrounding Paradise Season 3 in the months ahead.When will Paradise Season 3 premiere?No premiere date for Paradise Season 3 has been announced, but considering Season 1 debuted in late January 2025 and Season 2 kicked off in late February 2026, we’ll keep our hopes up that Season 3 could arrive around a similar time in 2027. And the future is already looking bright for the fans of the series as Fogelman posted a photo from set as Season 3 production commences.“S3. Let’s go.” Fogleman wrote on Instagram alongside an image of a viewframe featuring the cast with the words “Another Day in Paradise.” See the fun behind-the-scenes moment below:What has been said about Paradise Season 3?Julianne Nicholson in 'Paradise' Season 2Disney / Ser BaffoWhen TV Insider caught up with Brown during Season 1’s run, he shared, “I can tell you this, [Dan] has conceived, as a show, three seasons.. He’s like, ‘I’ve got three seasons in my head,’ and one thing I’ve learned is when Dan says, ‘I’ve got three seasons,’ he means, ‘I’ve got three seasons.'”For fans of Dan Fogelman’s previous series, This Is Us, a similar plan was devised as Fogelman envisioned the Pearson family’s story as a six-season journey. Ultimately, the show ran for six seasons. Whether Season 3 of Paradise will be the show’s last remains to be seen, as Hulu hasn’t designated it the final chapter yet.Who will star in Paradise Season 3?Paradise‘s current second season stars Sterling K. Brown, Julianne Nicholson, Sarah Shahi, Nicole Brydon Bloom, Krys Marshall, Enuka Okuma, Aliyah Mastin, Percy Daggs IV, and Charlie Evans, with James Marsden, Shailene Woodley, Thomas Doherty, and Jon Beavers serving as recurring guest stars. It’s unclear yet who will feature in Season 3, but we’d be willing to bet Brown will continue on to lead Season 3, and despite the show’s penchant for killing off characters, the door is open for any and all of the stars mentioned above, as Fogelman often incorporates characters, living or dead, into the story.Meanwhile, Deadline announced that Julianna Margulies would join Season 3 of the hit series in a role that’s being kept under wraps for now. Stay tuned to learn more as additional casting is announced.What will Paradise Season 3 be about?Stay tuned to see what Paradise Season 3 will be about, as no loglines have been unveiled yet. For fans less acquainted with the drama, Paradise follows Xavier Collins (Brown), a man who finds refuge in an underground bunker with his children when an apocalyptic weather event unfolds. When he discovers there are survivors above ground following a twisted murder mystery involving the president (James Marsden), he sets out to search for his wife, Teri (Okuma). Where the story will take viewers next remains to be seen as the mystery behind “Alex” unravels.Who makes Paradise Season 3?Paradise is created for television by Dan Fogelman, who executive produces the show with Jess Rosenthal, John Hoberg, Sterling K. Brown, Steve Beers, Glenn Ficarra, and John Requa. The series is a 20th Television production.Stay tuned for more details on Paradise, and let us know what you hope to see in Season 3 in the comments section.Paradise, Season 3 Premiere, TBA, HuluRead the latest entertainment news on TV Insider.
